projects.name: HTTP Server
projects.description: A lightweight HTTP/1.1 server built from scratch in C++ using raw Linux sockets and epoll — no frameworks. Handles non-blocking I/O, keep-alive, multiple simultaneous clients, and basic routing entirely from first principles.

projects.name: RL Cricket Agent
projects.description: A vision-only reinforcement learning agent that learns to play the browser game Little Cricket Master purely from screen pixels — no game API or memory access. Uses OpenCV and Kalman filtering for real-time ball tracking, with PPO handling shot decisions.

projects.name: SLCM Feedback Auto-Filler
projects.description: A Firefox browser extension that automatically fills out my college's feedback forms. It's picked up over 100 downloads on campus.

projects.name: TrackStack
projects.description: A VS Code extension that tracks real active coding time per project — not just how long the window was open — and reports an efficiency percentage. Live on the VS Code Marketplace with 14 installs.

projects.name: ASCII Video Player
projects.description: A real-time terminal video player that downloads YouTube videos and streams them as ASCII art, frame-by-frame, fully offline — converting frames in the background while playback runs in parallel.

projects.name: Raycaster Engine
projects.description: A minimalist 2.5D rendering engine built in pure C with OpenGL, inspired by Wolfenstein 3D. Casts rays per screen column to fake 3D depth from a 2D grid — no shaders, no game engine, just raw trigonometry.

projects.name: Average Coder
projects.description: A simple 2D browser game built with Kaboom.js.

projects.name: Simple Calculator
projects.description: A front-end calculator built with vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

projects.name: Tic-Tac-Toe AI
projects.description: Tic-tac-toe with an AI opponent powered by the minimax algorithm.

projects.name: Server Watcher
projects.description: An IoT-based temperature and humidity monitoring system with real-time alerts and a live dashboard. Currently in use by my college to monitor their server rooms. V2 in progress.

projects.name: Gesture Controlled Car
projects.description: A car that can be controlled using hand gestures.

projects.name: Krida
projects.description: A mobile application for booking sports facilities for MUJ and GHS, built with a team for college.
